challenges.title: Clinical downtime
challenges.desc: When clinical systems stop, care stops. Flat networks let one infection halt everything.

challenges.title: Patient data protection
challenges.desc: Hospitals hold sensitive health records that must stay private and in India.

challenges.title: Connected medical devices
challenges.desc: Devices that cannot be updated or secured need network-level protection.

approach.title: Separate clinical networks
approach.desc: Separate networks for medical devices, billing, staff and guests.

approach.title: Secure remote VPN
approach.desc: Secure VPN for doctors working remotely.

approach.title: Stay online
approach.desc: Multi-WAN failover and high availability to keep systems online.

indiaContext: A leading Indian hospital lost critical services for days to ransomware that spread across a flat network. Segmentation stops one infection becoming a shutdown. Patient data stays in India by default.
customerRef: Bombay Hospital · Shanti Devi GI Institute

faqs.q: Will SecuEdge Frontier interrupt clinical systems?
faqs.a: Protection levels let you choose. Mild is designed for sites that need the fewest interruptions.

faqs.q: Can we keep guest Wi-Fi away from clinical systems?
faqs.a: Yes, with separate networks and a guest login page.

faqs.q: Is the Safe Environment Filter available?

faqs.a: In India, by default. Traffic, logs and policy data stay on Indian soil, with no overseas routing.
